mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS answerId, a.question_id AS questionId, q.title AS questionTitle, a.like_count AS likeCount, LEFT(a.content, 100) AS contentPreview, a.status AS answerStatus, q.status AS questionStatus, CASE WHEN a.status = 1 AND q.status IN (1, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS effective, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_answer a JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = a.question_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND q.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id AS answerId, a.question_id AS questionId, q.title AS questionTitle, a.like_count AS likeCount, LEFT(a.content, 100) AS contentPreview, a.status AS answerStatus, q.status AS questionStatus, 1 AS effective, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_answer a JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = a.question_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.question_id AS questionId, a.content, a.image_urls AS imageUrlsRaw, a.user_id AS authorId, CASE WHEN a.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '匿名用户' ELSE u.nickname END AS authorName, CASE WHEN a.is_anonymous = 1 THEN NULL ELSE u.avatar END AS authorAvatar, a.is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, a.like_count AS likeCount, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_answer a LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId} AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.created_at ASC, a.id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.question_id AS questionId, a.content, a.image_urls AS imageUrlsRaw, a.user_id AS authorId, CASE WHEN a.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '匿名用户' ELSE u.nickname END AS authorName, CASE WHEN a.is_anonymous = 1 THEN NULL ELSE u.avatar END AS authorAvatar, a.is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, a.like_count AS likeCount, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_answer a LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.id = #{answerId} AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS answerId, a.question_id AS questionId, q.title AS questionTitle, LEFT(a.content, 140) AS contentPreview, a.like_count AS likeCount, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_answer a JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = a.question_id WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 AND (a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{term}, '%') OR q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{term}, '%')
) ORDER BY
a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC (a.like_count * 3 + q.view_count * 0.3) DESC, a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
(CASE WHEN a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 8 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
+ CASE WHEN a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{term}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{term}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
+ a.like_count * 2 + q.view_count * 0.2) DESC, a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.like_count), 0) FROM qa_answer a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qa_answer a JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = a.question_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qa_answer a JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = a.question_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status IN (1, 5)
